rules.statement: A Low-country Sinhalese man who has taken up his permanent residence in the District of Kandy and has married there under Kandyan Marriage Law is not considered a Kandyan for legal purposes.
rules.supporting_quote: "It cannot be maintained that what has been conserved as 'Kandyan Law' amounted to a distinct lex rei sitoe governing absolutely the devolution of land, like, for instance, gavelkind land in Kent. All we know is that a certain section of the community within the Kandyan Provinces, viz., the Kandyan Sinhalese, were allowed to retain their own customary law."
